description: Core transactional modules: Dashboard, Inventory, Sales, Purchases, Debtors, and Creditors pages with full CRUD, forms, ledgers, and hooks. Depends on FEAT-001 (types, dataLayer, utils) and FEAT-002 (UI primitives, layout, stubs). Replaces the stub pages created in FEAT-002.
steps: 1. Create src/hooks/useDashboard.ts: Calls getDataLayer().getDashboardStats(). Computes: todaySales, todayPurchases, todayExpenses, todayProfit (todaySales - todayPurchases - todayExpenses), monthlySales, monthlyProfit, totalProducts, totalStockUnits, totalInventoryValue, lowStockItems (current_stock <= min_stock_level), outOfStockItems (current_stock === 0), totalDebtors (sum customer balances > 0), totalCreditors (sum supplier balances > 0), overdueDebtors, overdueCreditors. Returns {stats, isLoading, error, refresh}. Also computes InsightAlert[] using rule engine: low-stock alert per product, overdue debtor alert, sales trend (compare this week vs last week), dead stock detection.

2. Create src/hooks/useProducts.ts: Wraps getDataLayer().getProducts(), addProduct(), updateProduct(), deleteProduct(). Returns {products, isLoading, error, addProduct, updateProduct, deleteProduct, refresh}. Computes derived fields: inventoryValue (stock * purchasePrice), isLowStock, isDead (via isDeadStock util).
3. Create src/hooks/useSales.ts: Wraps getDataLayer().getSales(from, to) and addSale(). Returns {sales, isLoading, error, addSale, refresh}. Accepts optional dateRange filter.
4. Create src/hooks/usePurchases.ts: Wraps getDataLayer().getPurchases(from, to) and addPurchase(). Returns {purchases, isLoading, error, addPurchase, refresh}.

5. Create src/hooks/useCustomers.ts: Wraps getDataLayer() customer methods + getCustomerTransactions(id) + addCustomerTransaction(). Returns {customers, isLoading, error, addCustomer, updateCustomer, getTransactions, addTransaction, refresh}.

6. Create src/hooks/useSuppliers.ts: Wraps getDataLayer() supplier methods + getSupplierTransactions(id) + addSupplierTransaction(). Returns {suppliers, isLoading, error, addSupplier, updateSupplier, getTransactions, addTransaction, refresh}.
7. Create src/hooks/useExpenses.ts: Wraps getDataLayer().getExpenses(from, to) and addExpense(). Returns {expenses, isLoading, error, addExpense, refresh}.

8. Create src/components/dashboard/StatCard.tsx: KPI card showing icon, label, value (formatted currency or number), trend indicator (+X% vs last period with up/down arrow). Green for positive trend, red for negative. Accepts: icon (Lucide), label, value, trend?, trendLabel?, color variant (primary|success|warning|danger|info).

9. Create src/components/dashboard/SalesChart.tsx: Recharts AreaChart showing daily sales for last 30 days. X-axis: date (DD MMM), Y-axis: ₹ amount. Tooltip shows date + revenue + profit. Color: indigo for revenue, emerald for profit. Responsive container.

10. Create src/components/dashboard/TopProductsChart.tsx: Recharts BarChart (horizontal) showing top 5 products by quantity sold this month. X-axis: quantity, Y-axis: product name. Color indigo bars. Tooltip.
11. Create src/components/dashboard/ExpenseChart.tsx: Recharts PieChart showing expense breakdown by category this month. Colors: distinct palette. Legend below chart. Center label: total expenses.
12. Create src/components/dashboard/ProfitChart.tsx: Recharts LineChart showing weekly profit for last 12 weeks. Two lines: gross profit (indigo) and net profit (emerald). Dot markers.

13. Create src/components/dashboard/InsightsPanel.tsx: Renders list of InsightAlert items. Each alert is a colored card: icon + title + description + optional action button. Types: LOW_STOCK (amber), DEAD_STOCK (red), OVERDUE_DEBTOR (orange), OVERDUE_CREDITOR (blue), SALES_TREND_UP (green), SALES_TREND_DOWN (red), RESTOCK_SOON (amber). If no alerts: show EmptyState 'All good! No alerts today.'

14. Create src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx (replace stub): Layout in grid. Row 1: 6 StatCards (Today's Sales, Today's Profit, Monthly Sales, Inventory Value, Total Receivable, Total Payable) — responsive grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3. Row 2: SalesChart (2/3 width) + InsightsPanel (1/3 width). Row 3: TopProductsChart + ExpenseChart side by side. Row 4: ProfitChart full width. Page title 'Dashboard'. Date shown at top right. Demo mode banner at top: 'Running in Demo Mode — connect Supabase to save data permanently.'

15. Create src/components/inventory/ProductForm.tsx: React Hook Form form with Zod schema. Fields: name (required), category (select from categories), sku, brand, unit (select: kg/ltr/pkt/bar/btl/pcs/dozen), purchasePrice (₹, required), sellingPrice (₹, required, must be >= purchasePrice), currentStock (number, default 0), minStockLevel (number, default 0), supplierId (select from suppliers), expiryDate (date, optional). Shows profit margin % calculated live as user types prices. Submit calls addProduct or updateProduct.

16. Create src/components/inventory/ProductTable.tsx: Full product listing. Columns: Product (name + SKU + brand), Category, Stock (quantity + unit, red if low/out), Purchase Price, Selling Price, Margin %, Inventory Value, Status badge (In Stock / Low Stock / Out of Stock / Dead Stock), Actions (Edit pencil, Delete trash). Clicking row name → navigates to product detail if needed. Supports search by name/SKU, filter by category, filter by status.

17. Create src/pages/InventoryPage.tsx (replace stub): Header with 'Inventory' title + 'Add Product' button. SearchBar + filter dropdowns (category, status). Summary row: total products, total value, low stock count, out of stock count — as mini stat chips. ProductTable. 'Add Product' button opens ProductForm in a Modal. Edit button opens same modal pre-filled. Delete shows confirmation dialog. Show loading spinner while loading.

18. Create src/components/sales/SaleForm.tsx: Multi-line sale entry. Header: date (default today), customer (optional select), payment method (cash/upi/credit). Items section: add rows of [product select, quantity, unit price (auto-filled from product selling price, editable), subtotal]. Add Item button. Auto-calculates: subtotal per line, total, estimated gross profit (total - sum of cost prices). Submit calls addSale(header, items[]). On credit sale: shows customer balance update preview.

19. Create src/components/sales/SalesTable.tsx: Sales list. Columns: Date, Invoice#, Customer, Items (count), Total (₹), Profit (₹), Payment Method badge, Actions (view). Supports date range filter. Shows daily total row at bottom.

20. Create src/pages/SalesPage.tsx (replace stub): Header 'Sales' + 'Record Sale' button. DateRangePicker default last 7 days. Summary chips: total sales, total profit, avg per day. SalesTable. Record Sale opens SaleForm modal.

21. Create src/components/purchases/PurchaseForm.tsx: Similar to SaleForm but for purchases. Fields: date, supplier (select), payment status (paid/credit/partial). Items: product, quantity, unit price (auto-fills from product purchase price, editable). Auto-calculates total. Submit calls addPurchase.
22. Create src/components/purchases/PurchasesTable.tsx: Columns: Date, Supplier, Items (count), Total (₹), Payment Status badge, Actions.
23. Create src/pages/PurchasesPage.tsx (replace stub): Header + 'Record Purchase' button. DateRangePicker. Summary chips. PurchasesTable. Modal for PurchaseForm.
24. Create src/components/debtors/CustomerForm.tsx: Fields: name (required), mobile, address, opening balance (₹, default 0), due date, notes. Zod validation. Add/edit mode.

25. Create src/components/debtors/CustomerList.tsx: Grid of customer cards (or table on desktop). Each card: customer name + mobile, outstanding balance (red if > 0, green if 0), last transaction date, overdue badge if past due date. Click → navigate to /debtors/:id.

26. Create src/components/debtors/CustomerLedger.tsx: For a single customer. Shows: customer info header (name, mobile, address, due date). Outstanding balance chip. Transaction table: Date | Description | Debit (Credit Sale) | Credit (Payment) | Balance. Running balance per row. Cumulative total at bottom. 'Record Payment' button opens mini form: amount, date, notes. 'Record Credit Sale' link. Print ledger button.

27. Create src/pages/DebtorsPage.tsx (replace stub): Header 'Debtors (Customers Who Owe)' + 'Add Customer' button. Total receivable banner: '₹XX,XXX pending from X customers'. SearchBar. CustomerList. Add Customer modal.
28. Create src/pages/DebtorDetailPage.tsx (replace stub): Reads :id param. Shows CustomerLedger for that customer. Back button → /debtors.
29. Create src/components/creditors/SupplierForm.tsx: Same structure as CustomerForm but for suppliers. Fields: name, contact person, mobile, address, opening balance, due date, notes.
30. Create src/components/creditors/SupplierList.tsx: Same pattern as CustomerList but shows supplier data. Balance label: 'You owe'. Navigate to /creditors/:id.
31. Create src/components/creditors/SupplierLedger.tsx: Same pattern as CustomerLedger. 'Record Payment to Supplier' button. Running balance.
32. Create src/pages/CreditorsPage.tsx (replace stub): Header 'Creditors (Suppliers You Owe)' + 'Add Supplier' button. Total payable banner. SupplierList. Add Supplier modal.
33. Create src/pages/CreditorDetailPage.tsx (replace stub): Reads :id param. SupplierLedger. Back button → /creditors.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build passes with zero errors
Dashboard page renders 6 stat cards and at least 2 charts using seed data without errors
Inventory page lists all 10 seed products with correct stock levels and inventory values
Add Product form validates required fields and shows error messages for invalid input
Sales page shows sales from seed data in the table, filterable by date range
Record Sale form auto-fills selling price when a product is selected
Debtors page shows all 5 seed customers with their outstanding balances
Clicking a customer navigates to /debtors/:id and shows the transaction ledger
Creditors page shows 3 seed suppliers with their outstanding balances
All forms use React Hook Form + Zod — submitting empty required fields shows inline error messages
